reviewer_context: separate OpenAI agent; unblinded focused revision review following blind first pass and key/source review
verification_scope: Unblinded focused review. Read current inputs and keys and semantically compared all 36 cases with frozen v1. Read all 12 current incident pattern synopses after P02 correction; assessed them against the already-read primary reports. No new browsing or reproduction.
overall_verdict: accept revised cases and current historical pattern synopses

case_verdicts.reason: Narrowed cause matches current observations: cached startup, simultaneous LIST requests and above-limit API-server memory pressure. It no longer imports an unobserved previous rollout or OOM termination.

E2 now explicitly supplies role removal before successful instance-profile deletion and labels the audit fictional. The sequence is technically coherent and does not falsely attribute the call to the historical report.

E3 separates regular Pod-update nodeSelector immutability from kubelet pods/status label rejection under enabled NodeRestriction and node identity; the updated cause identifies why completion status fails.
Only contradicted_cause was synchronized with the revised rollout cause. Observations and expected alternative remain unchanged.
Only contradicted_cause was synchronized with the revised webhook cause. Successful status plus orphaned cleanup finalizer still supports the alternative.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Matches reported update-triggered networkd restart and loss of routing rules; does not imply every networkd restart behaves this way.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: Cross-node pod connections timed out after a routine maintenance window. Historical context: Datadog reports that a systemd-networkd restart removed pod routing rules during unattended updates across environments. Useful checks: Compare host routing and maintenance history with cloud firewall decisions for the failed packet path.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Corrected to host VM memory exhaustion; removed the unverified configured API-server limit from historical context.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: A node-agent rollout coincided with API timeouts and slow scheduling. Historical context: Reddit reports that cached-image startup synchronized large LIST requests and exhausted control-plane VM memory. Useful checks: Compare audit request concurrency and API memory with etcd fsync latency and the rollout start-time distribution.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Acceptable short abstraction of invalid/absent namespace configuration and destructive reconciliation. Empty desired state should not be read as a literal recovered historical manifest.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: Services vanished from the cluster shortly after an infrastructure change. Historical context: Skyscanner reports a templating change producing an empty desired state and automated reconciliation deleting resources. Useful checks: Inspect rendered desired state and the identity, timestamps and targets of resource deletion audit events.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Matches reported selector change, concentrated load and memory failure.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: A rolling update stalled while new pods repeatedly ran out of memory. Historical context: Grafana reports a Service selector excluding old replicas, concentrating traffic on a small updated subset and causing OOMs. Useful checks: Compare Service selectors and EndpointSlices with per-pod traffic and equal-workload memory profiles.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Explicitly separates verified reported deletion/delayed effects from fictional expiry details and prerequisite audit calls.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: Cloud API access stopped and replacement nodes failed after a quiet interval. Historical context: Stytch reports a deleted shared instance profile, failed replacement provisioning and delayed failures on existing nodes. Exact credential expiry and role-removal API calls are fixture details, not verified historical observations. Useful checks: Inspect instance-profile references and audit history, credential expiry and trusted clock offset without exposing credentials.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Acceptable endpoint-level synopsis of reported NEG removal despite blocked pod eviction; does not generalize controller behavior to all providers.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: A running Redis pod became unreachable through its internal load balancer. Historical context: GitLab reports that a PDB prevented Redis pod eviction while a GKE controller independently removed its load-balancer endpoint. Useful checks: Compare direct pod reachability, endpoint-group membership, target health and network-policy drop evidence.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Matches report of stale bundled trust roots and retained connections masking handshake failure.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: Newly deployed pods fail TLS calls while old pods continue serving. Historical context: Shopify reports an expired root and stale client trust bundle; existing TLS connections concealed the problem until pod replacement forced new handshakes. Useful checks: Compare fresh versus reused connections, certificate SAN/validity, request hostname and the actual client trust store.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Matches file-heavy volume ownership traversal delaying startup; contains no unsupported universal mitigation promise.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: A stateful tool takes a long time to start after replacement. Historical context: Cloudflare reports long pod startup delays while kubelet recursively changed volume group ownership across many files. Useful checks: Establish whether delay occurs during attach, mount, ownership processing or application initialization.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Appropriately qualifies the precise kernel mechanism and marks stronger experimental observations as fictional.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: Rare search latency spikes appeared after moving workloads to Kubernetes. Historical context: Pinterest links rare latency to cAdvisor memory inspection. The precise kernel locking explanation remains qualified; direct lock traces and a controlled re-enable experiment in our exercise are fictional evidence. Useful checks: Correlate tail requests with profiles, collector timing and GC pauses; use a bounded isolated comparison.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Retains uncertainty about the underlying cleanup problem. Read this as uncertainty about why cleanup failed; the report itself documents stale mappings and a failed conntrack-delete log.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: Some pods have intermittent DNS timeouts after CoreDNS scaled down. Historical context: Preply reports DNS failures after CoreDNS scale-down with traffic directed to a removed endpoint. The underlying conntrack cleanup failure was not conclusively established. Useful checks: Inspect failing flow destinations and policy decisions; do not claim the underlying conntrack cleanup defect without more evidence.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Accurately keeps ordinary Pod nodeSelector failures separate from kubelet status label failures.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: A simulation finished its workload but never completed cleanup. Historical context: ACRL reports a fail-open webhook certificate race followed by mutation errors: ordinary Pod updates failed on nodeSelector changes and kubelet status updates failed on label changes. Useful checks: Inspect admission timing and rules, accepted status updates, deletionTimestamp, finalizers and their owning controller.

pattern_verdicts.reason: Matches moved package/hardcoded URL preventing bootstrap and node registration, without claiming the synthetic 404 was the historical error.
pattern_verdicts.reviewed_text: Autoscaling launched instances but application pods remain Pending. Historical context: FREE NOW reports that a moved package invalidated a hardcoded bootstrap URL, leaving launched worker instances unable to join Kubernetes. Useful checks: Compare cloud instance counts with node registration, then inspect bootstrap completion and API authentication errors.

coverage.rationale: All ids/order are unchanged. No fields changed except the two evidence arrays and four cause fields shown in semantic_diff. Every unchanged case retains its original review disposition; the previously requested case revisions are now accepted. Pattern historical provenance is assessed separately.
coverage.evidence_changes: Exactly IAM E2 and webhook E3 changed; all other evidence ids/text, questions, environment fields and synthetic flags are unchanged.
coverage.pattern_comparison_limit: No frozen v1 incident_patterns.json was provided. All current synopses were reviewed against prior source findings; a full historical pattern-file diff is not claimed. Builder implementation was not inspected in this review.

old.text: 19:10Z the simulation process exited successfully, but its pod remains and the simulation controller waits for cleanup.
19:00Z webhook TLS validation failed before CA injection; failurePolicy=Ignore admitted the simulation pod onto a real node.
19:10Z after CA injection, UPDATE admission adds nodeSelector and labels to pod/status updates; API rejects the mutation and kubelet retries completion status.

new.text: 19:10Z the simulation process exited successfully, but its pod remains and the simulation controller waits for cleanup.
19:00Z webhook TLS validation failed before CA injection; failurePolicy=Ignore admitted the simulation pod onto a real node.

19:10Z after CA injection, the webhook matches UPDATE requests for both pods and pods/status. A job-controller ordinary Pod update is rejected because the webhook adds an immutable nodeSelector. Separately, the webhook adds labels to a kubelet pods/status update; with NodeRestriction enabled, admission rejects the label change from the node identity, and completion status never persists.

remaining_limits: The suite is synthetic and was not reproduced in Kubernetes. Acceptance means coherence with supplied evidence and the limited source review.
Historical reports are author accounts; source confirmation is not independent forensic verification.
Version-pinned Kubernetes source establishes plausibility, not a live test of all admission-order and cluster-configuration details.
Pattern synopses are short abstractions. In P10, the remaining uncertainty concerns why conntrack cleanup failed, not whether the report contained a failed-delete observation.
Acceptance applies only to the recorded artifact hashes. No unread future edit is approved.
